Welcome! I'm really glad you're here with me—because together, we're about to dive into a journey that just might change the way you think about making decisions.
Have you ever trusted your gut in a high-pressure moment, only to wonder later if that hunch led you astray? You're not alone. It turns out, even the most seasoned business leaders can fall into hidden mental shortcuts and cognitive traps that quietly steer us off course.
That’s exactly what Gleb Tsipursky explores in his eye-opening book, "Never Go With Your Gut." Rather than celebrating intuition as our best friend, he invites us to look a little deeper—challenging us to recognize the subtle forces that can sabotage even our smartest decisions.
What if we could spot those psychological pitfalls before they cost us dearly? Imagine leading with clarity, confidence, and strategies rooted in science, not just instinct. Throughout this journey, we'll uncover real-world stories, cutting-edge research, and practical frameworks—all designed to help us question assumptions, sharpen our judgment, and make choices that truly stand the test of time.
So, as we set out together, get ready to discover not only why our instincts sometimes let us down, but how we can use evidence-based tools to rise above those traps. Whether you're leading a team or just looking to make better decisions every day, this exploration is for you.
Let’s get started and see what happens when we move beyond the gut—and step into a smarter, more intentional way of thinking.
